navigation_notes: Village Parkway runs along the west side of campus; Brighton Drive runs along the south side.
The PAC and Building C are on the north side of campus, next to the Gym (Building E) and Building F.
Admin Building A, the Library/Hub, and Building B are clustered in the center of campus.
The Student Union, Building J, Building K, Building L, Building M, and Building N are on the south side of campus, closest to Brighton Drive.
The Sports Complex and Track & Field are on the east side of campus.
A pedestrian bridge connects the north end of campus to the Iron Horse Trail.
